# FOF Ops

> FOF Ops runs Foundation of Faith, The Covenant Nation Ikorodu's 10-week course. Other church apps can ask it about people and cohorts through the FOF API.

## API

- [FOF API docs](/api-docs.html): getting a key, scopes, limits, errors and every endpoint.
- The machine-readable description (OpenAPI 3.1) is served by the API at `/v1/openapi.json`; its source is `supabase/functions/public-api/openapi.json` in the repository.
